correctness.rationale: Minkowski–Hölder yields the upper bound and a geometric radial input yields the matching lower bound, establishing the full fixed-p limit. On each branch, positivity of the inverse forces a radial smallest eigenmode. The displayed exact secular equation follows from the leaf boundary and characteristic roots. Taylor expansion around the rigorously small root gives the explicit finite-depth coefficient and its remainder. All 195 independently computed finite consistency assertions passed; no computation is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The discrete ancestor-summation map is a natural Hardy/Poincaré model on expanding regular trees. The exact all-p coefficient settles its asymptotic best constant instead of only bounds; the depth-enhanced exponentially small second term quantifies the convergence of the associated root-Dirichlet spectral gap and is not determined by generic Hardy estimates. This is a structurally motivated benchmark rather than an arbitrary finite computation.
